How to use this book

IMPULSE LEARNING CENTER
1. Ask and answer

Work in pairs. One student asks the questions, the other answers. Then swap.

2. Check the words

Look at Words & phrases before you start. Use at least three in your answers.

3. Use a starter

Begin with an answer starter, then add your own ideas.

4. Say more

Answer + reason (because…) + example (for example…).

Four kinds of lessons

Speaking

Give a full answer: say what, then add a reason with because or so.

Vocabulary & Skills

Use each new word in a sentence about your own life.

Speaking & Writing

Plan your answer in note form first, then say it without reading.

Video

Before you answer, say two things you already know about the topic.

Make your answer longer

A1I like my city.
A2I like my city because it’s friendly and there’s a lot to do.
A2+I really like my city because it’s friendly and there’s a lot to do. For example, I often go to the park with my friends. However, the traffic can be terrible.

Linking words

andalsobuthoweverbecausesofor examplefirstthenfinallyIn my opinion…

Need time to think?

  • “That’s a good question.”
  • “Let me think …”
  • “Well, I’m not sure, but I think …”
